title: When the Drop Sings
author: Quentin Lockridge
blurb: Casper Yarrow, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
